fastShipping.title: Tracked, protected shipping
fastShipping.description: Every order ships with a tracked courier, usually within three business days, with cards in sleeves and toploaders.

support.title: Dedicated support
support.description: Write to us by email or WhatsApp: we reply within 48 business hours.

prices.title: Always up-to-date prices
prices.description: We align our prices with the market several times a day, so you pay the right price for every card.

security.title: Protected data
security.description: Your personal and payment data are protected with industry-standard encryption.

marquee.sell: Sell your collection: appraisal by appointment

hero.lead: Singles, sealed packs and boxes, picked by collectors for collectors. Find the piece your collection is missing: we ship it within three business days, always protected.

story.label: From the pack to your table

pack.text: There's always a chance inside: that's why every opening makes your heart race. Packs and boxes reach you sealed, exactly as they left the factory.

fan.text: The best card always sits at the back. Anyone who has opened a pack knows it, and so do we.

hit.text: Holo, reverse, full art, special illustrations: the rarity that makes your hands shake. And if you'd rather not trust luck, it's already among our singles.

safe.text: Every order leaves within three business days and always travels protected, because a perfect card must arrive perfect.

categories.title: What are you looking for?
categories.lead: From the card your collection is missing to the box to open with friends.

opening.lead: Pick one of the Japanese packs we stock and open it here, for free. Only Japanese cards from that set come out, taken from our singles in stock: if you like the one you pull, it's already for sale. And if you enjoyed the thrill, the real pack is one click away.

facts.set: cards from the set in stock

sell.title: Got a collection in a drawer?
sell.lead: We'll appraise it, calmly and by appointment. Book an appraisal and find out what it's really worth.

newsletter.title: Gotta catch us!
newsletter.header: Join our community and get special offers delivered straight to your inbox!

caption.first: Discover all the benefits of staying updated with one click: exclusive previews, special promotions, detailed insights, and personalized reminders for your purchases, all without cluttering your inbox. Sign up now and get a
